scope: Private/house labels, regional U.S. brands, adaptive apparel/footwear, technical outdoor/cycling, boutique children's labels, and newer independent designers.

methodology.sizing_policy: Brand inclusion is independent of sizing. Verified product/brand sizing overrides the generic low-confidence S/M/L/XL fallback for compatible apparel.

validation_notes: Tillys currently identifies RSQ, Full Tilt, West of Melrose and Tillys as owned brands.
Zumiez currently presents A.LAB and Ninth Hall as exclusive labels; Empyre and Zine remain active brand storefronts.
PacSun currently carries LA Hearts and identifies PAC 1980 and PS Basics in current fashion merchandising.
Current adaptive-market sources confirm active specialists including IZ Adaptive, Silverts, BILLY Footwear, MagnaReady, No Limbits and Joe & Bella.
Current cycling sources continue to identify Pas Normal Studios, Velocio, Rapha, ASSOS, Q36.5, Endura, Pearl Izumi and related technical brands.
Current official storefronts confirm active emerging designers including Jane Wade, LEBLANCSTUDIOS, Elena Velez, Connor McKnight, Wiederhoeft, Gabe Gordon and Dauphinette.
